title: Username path gets truncated, causing PowerToys to create config files in a wrong C:\Users\<truncated_name> folder
summary: This is a high-impact configuration-path defect with a clear reproduction and concrete filesystem evidence across both stable and preview releases. The exact path handling mechanism and affected component ownership should be investigated before asserting a root cause.

status.label: Design in progress
status.detail: A detailed implementation-grade design is being prepared. No maintainer action is exposed until the design is complete and validated.

judgment.rationale: This is a high-impact configuration-path defect with a clear reproduction and concrete filesystem evidence across both stable and preview releases. The exact path handling mechanism and affected component ownership should be investigated before asserting a root cause.
evidence: The reporter reproduces the behavior in PowerToys 0.100.2 stable and 0.101.2312.0 preview.
PowerToys creates C:\Users\2514 while the actual profile directory is C:\Users\25146.
The unexpected directory contains Keyboard Manager default.json and settings.json, while the real profile contains different configuration contents.
The issue affects General and Installer behavior and has no assignee or visible linked work.
judgment.recommended_action: Prioritize a design investigation of profile-directory discovery and configuration-path construction, including installer and per-user/per-machine launch paths.
